import json, os, random, subprocess, sys, tempfile, time
SUB="/app/submission/main.py"; PY=sys.executable
rng=random.Random(5)
rules=[]
for i in range(2048):
    ranges=[]
    for _ in range(8):
        lo=rng.randint(-2048,2040); ranges.append([lo, lo+rng.randint(0,8)])
    rules.append({"id":i,"class":i%65536,"priority":rng.randint(-2**31,2**31-1),"ranges":ranges})
def wide(d):
    if d==0: return {"class":1}
    return {"feature":0,"threshold":0,"le":wide(d-1),"gt":wide(d-1)}
cfg={"version":1,"idle_timeout":1000000000,"packet_limit":1000000000,"prefix_width":32,
     "rules":rules,"fallback":wide(7)}
blob=json.dumps(cfg).encode()
print("config bytes", len(blob))
t0=time.time()
p=subprocess.run([PY,"-I",SUB,"compile"],input=blob,stdout=subprocess.PIPE,stderr=subprocess.PIPE)
print("compile rc",p.returncode,"time %.2f"%(time.time()-t0),"out bytes",len(p.stdout))
if p.returncode: print(p.stdout[:200], p.stderr.decode()[-500:]); sys.exit(1)
prog=json.loads(p.stdout)
canon=json.dumps(prog,sort_keys=True,separators=(',',':'),ensure_ascii=True).encode('ascii')
print("canonical program bytes",len(canon),"limit 32MiB", 32*1024*1024)
with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as tmp:
    path=os.path.join(tmp,"p.json"); open(path,'wb').write(p.stdout)
    reqs=[{"op":"open","flow":1,"time":0}]
    t=0
    for i in range(20000):
        t+=1
        reqs.append({"op":"chunk","packets":[{"flow":1,"time":t,"source":i%2,"length":rng.randint(1,2048)}]})
    reqs.append({"op":"close","flow":1,"time":t+1})
    data=("\n".join(json.dumps(r) for r in reqs)+"\n").encode()
    t0=time.time()
    p2=subprocess.run([PY,"-I",SUB,"stream",path],input=data,stdout=subprocess.PIPE,stderr=subprocess.PIPE)
    print("stream rc",p2.returncode,"time %.2f"%(time.time()-t0), "outbytes",len(p2.stdout))
    print(p2.stderr.decode()[-300:])
PYEOF
cd /app/tmp/work && timeout 600 python3 maxcfg.py
